# Bokmål glossary: words the Norwegian spell check accepts although the
# dictionary rejects them. One word per line; '#' starts a comment;
# matching is case-insensitive. run.mjs subtracts these from hunspell's
# findings, so the file stays plain UTF-8 regardless of the dictionary's
# own encoding.
#
# The dictionary is full-form (inflections are separate entries), so an
# accepted term's other forms need their own lines — add them as the check
# reports them.
#
# Keep this to names and genuine domain terms. A misspelling "fixed" by a
# glossary entry stays wrong in the product, so prefer fixing the text.
# Review of this file in a PR IS the native-speaker check: every line is a
# claim that the word is correct Norwegian (or a name/technical term used
# deliberately) — remove a line to re-flag the word everywhere.

# Product and organisation names
